name: John D. Hadden
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: John Hadden is an experienced trial and appellate litigator practicing in the areas of personal injury and wrongful death, and insurance litigation. John has appeared as both lead counsel and amicus curiae in numerous cases before the Georgia Supreme Court and Court of Appeals. He is a graduate of Emory University and the University of Georgia School of Law, where he was a member of the Georgia Law Review . He is an active member of the American Association for Justice, where he has served on the Board of Governors for the New Lawyers Division and the Amicus Curiae Committee, and the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he is a member and past Chair of the the Amicus Curiae Committee and a frequent speaker at its seminars. John is a past Chair of the Litigation Section of the Atlanta Bar Association and a member of the Atlanta Bar Board of Directors as well as the Board of Trustees of the Atlanta Bar's Lawyer Referral and Information Service. John is a 2011 graduate of the State Bar of Georgia's YLD Leadership Academy, past chair of the YLD's litigation committee, and current chair of the Atlanta Trial Lawyers Association. John's litigation experience spans hundreds of cases and includes representing individuals, businesses, and insurers, as both plaintiffs and defendants, in state and federal courts in matters involving corporate disputes, catastrophic personal injuries and wrongful death, insurance disputes, and asbestos litigation.

John is author of two treatises on Georgia law: Green's Georgia Law of Evidence and Georgia Law of Torts - Trial Preparation and Practice , both published by Thomson Reuters Westlaw. He is also author of the evidence chapter of the Thomson Reuters treatise Handling Motor Vehicle Accident Cases .

John is admitted to practice before all Georgia trial and appellate courts (Georgia Court of Appeals and Georgia Supreme Court), as well as all federal district (trial) courts in Georgia (Northern, Middle, and Southern Districts), the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court. He is also a registered mediator with the Georgia Office of Dispute Resolution, and is chairman of the board for the Georgia Network to End Sexual Assault.
